description: A squat bottle of juniper spirit, cloudy at the shoulder where something botanical refused to dissolve. Tastes like a pine forest that owes money. Drinkable neat if you've had a day; better in a pan, where the alcohol boils off and leaves the perfume behind.
name: bottle of gin
